paper_title: Adversarial Online Learning with Temporal Feedback Graphs
statement: We leave it as an interesting open question to characterize the gap between ILB(S) and UB(S). We conjecture that this gap is at most a universal constant (thus showing that both Algorithm 1 and this lower bound are optimal up to constant factors).
context: Theorem 11 Every S-learning algorithm A must incur worst-case regret Reg(A) ≥ ILB(S)/50. We leave it as an interesting open question to characterize the gap between ILB(S) and UB(S). We conjecture that this gap is at most a universal constant (thus showing that both Algorithm 1 and this lower bound are optimal up to constant factors). Conjecture 12 There exists a constant γ such that for any temporal feedback graph S, UB(S)/ILB(S) ≤ γ. In particular, in Appendix A we employ a variant of this technique to prove a tight lower bound for all transitive graphs, providing partial evidence for this conjecture.
